children.abstract: Tree-sitter walk extracting Julia modules, structs, abstract types, functions, imports, and call edges.

children.title: extract_verilog
children.abstract: Tree-sitter walk extracting Verilog/SystemVerilog modules, functions, tasks, package imports, and instantiations.

children.title: extract_cpp

children.title: extract_csharp

children.title: extract_php

children.title: extract_ruby

children.title: extract_scala

children.title: extract_swift

children.abstract: Raises ImportError/RuntimeError if tree-sitter is missing or older than the required Language API v2 (>=0.23.0).

children.title: collect_files
children.abstract: Walks a target path collecting source files by known extension, respecting .dummyindexignore and symlink containment.

children.title: extract
children.abstract: Top-level extraction entry: runs per-file tree-sitter extraction with caching, then cross-file import/call resolution.

children.title: common.py
children.abstract: Shared AST-extraction building blocks: _make_id (stable node id), _read_text, _find_body — used by every language extractor.

children.title: _find_body
children.abstract: Finds a node's body via config.body_field, falling back to matching child types in config.body_fallback_child_types.

children.title: _make_id
children.abstract: Builds a stable lowercase node ID by joining and sanitizing name parts into an underscore-separated slug.

children.title: _read_text
children.abstract: Decodes a tree-sitter node's byte range from source into UTF-8 text, replacing invalid bytes.

children.title: config.py
children.abstract: LanguageConfig dataclass: declares per-grammar quirks (node-type sets, name/body fields, call accessors, import/resolve callables) driving _extract_generic.

children.title: LanguageConfig
children.abstract: Dataclass parametrizing _extract_generic per language: tree-sitter node/name/body fields and call/import handlers.

children.title: generic.py
children.abstract: _extract_generic: the ~600-line parametric tree-sitter driver (~12 languages) emitting class/function/method nodes, import edges, and a second-pass call graph.

children.title: _extract_generic
children.abstract: Parametric tree-sitter driver: emits class/function/import nodes+edges per LanguageConfig, then walks call graphs.

children.title: helpers.py
children.abstract: Per-language name-resolution and grammar-quirk helpers: C/C++ declarator unwrapping and _<lang>_extra_walk passes for arrow functions, namespaces, enum cases.

children.title: _csharp_extra_walk
children.abstract: Handles C# namespace_declaration nodes in the generic walker, emitting a namespace node and recursing into its body.

children.title: _get_c_func_name
children.abstract: Recursively unwraps a C function declarator to find the innermost identifier naming the function.

children.title: _get_cpp_func_name
children.abstract: Recursively unwraps a C++ function declarator (handling qualified_identifier) to find the function's name.

children.title: _js_extra_walk
children.abstract: Handles JS/TS lexical_declaration nodes to detect arrow-function assignments and register them as function nodes.

children.title: _swift_extra_walk
children.abstract: Handles Swift enum_entry nodes, emitting a case node with a case_of edge to the parent enum.

children.title: imports.py

children.title: _import_c
children.abstract: Extracts a C #include target from string_literal/system_lib_string children and appends an 'imports' edge.

children.title: _import_csharp
children.abstract: Extracts a C# using-directive target name and appends an 'imports' edge to it.

children.title: _import_java
children.abstract: Walks a scoped_identifier/identifier import path to build the dotted module name and appends an 'imports' edge.

children.title: _import_js
children.abstract: Resolves a JS/TS import string to a target node id, handling relative paths (.js->.ts remap) vs bare package names.

children.title: _import_kotlin
children.abstract: Extracts a Kotlin import path (via path field or identifier fallback) and appends an 'imports' edge.

children.title: _import_lua
children.abstract: Regex-matches require('module') calls inside Lua variable_declaration text and appends an 'imports' edge.

children.title: _import_php
children.abstract: Extracts a PHP use-statement's qualified/name identifier and appends an 'imports' edge to its last segment.

children.title: _import_python
children.abstract: Handles Python import_statement and import_from_statement nodes, resolving relative imports, appending edges.

children.title: _import_scala
children.abstract: Extracts a Scala import's stable_id/identifier module name (skipping wildcard '_') and appends an 'imports' edge.

children.title: _import_swift
children.abstract: Extracts a Swift import statement's identifier and appends an 'imports' edge to it.

children.title: _extract_python_rationale
children.abstract: Post-pass mutating extraction results in-place with docstring and rationale-comment (# NOTE:/# TODO:/etc) nodes+edges.

children.title: _resolve_cross_file_java_imports

children.abstract: Walks a root (plus extra doc roots), classifies every file, converts office docs, returns a summary of counts.

children.abstract: Function superproject_root at dummyindex/pipeline/io/git.py:87.
